goalTextEn: Can introduce yourself and your coworker.
goalTextKr: 자기소개와 동료 소개를 할 수 있게 된다.

introduce.goalEn: Can introduce yourself and your coworker.
introduce.goalKr: 자기소개와 동료 소개를 할 수 있게 된다.
introduce.situationEn: A new coworker joins your team. Introduce yourself and another coworker to him/her.
introduce.situationKr: 팀에 새 직원이 배치되었습니다. 먼저 자기소개를 한 다음, 팀원들을 그/그녀에게 소개합시다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we're going to talk about introducing yourself and your coworker."
Read the lesson goal aloud.
Ask the student to repeat the goal.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation clearly.
"Is it clear? Let's go to the next part."
For Listening lessons, focus on the student's understanding. Use a slow speaking pace and repeat sections twice or more if needed.

vocabulary.definition: to become a member of a group

pronunciation.instruction: Let's practice saying words with /æ/ and /ʌ/.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's look at patterns used in introducing yourself and your coworker."
Read each pattern aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
Explain when to use each pattern.
"Do you have any questions about the patterns?"
"Now, we have the useful vocabulary."
Read each word. Ask the student to repeat.
For lower-level students, give simple definitions. Send pronunciation guides via chat if needed: pleased [pleezd], coworker [KOH-wur-ker], join [join].

understand.instruction: You can use these patterns to introduce yourself and a coworker.
understand.instructionKr: 자기소개와 동료 소개 시, 다음 패턴을 사용합니다.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's practice saying words with /æ/ and /ʌ/."
Teach the student how to pronounce /æ/ and /ʌ/ using mouth movements.
Read each word, then ask the student to repeat.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.
For /æ/, the mouth opens wider (like "cat"). For /ʌ/, the mouth is more relaxed (like "cup").
"Now, let's read the patterns in the table."
Read each sentence in the table. Ask the student to repeat.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.
For lower-level students, explain how each sentence is used.

steps.title: Step 1 — Repeat After Your Tutor
steps.content:
Introducing Yourself → Introducing Your Coworker

My name is Chen. → This is Robert.
My name is Ronald. → This is Janette.
My name is Esther. → This is Tony.
My name is Rachelle. → This is Carol.
My name is Arthur. → This is Hiro.

We are coworkers. • We are teammates.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's practice today's patterns."
Read each sentence. Ask the student to repeat.
Adjust speed according to the student's level.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.

steps.title: Step 2 — Fill in the Blanks
steps.instructionEn: Fill in with "My name is," "This is," or "We are."
steps.instructionKr: "My name is", "This is", "We are" 중 하나를 넣으세요.
steps.content:
Introducing Yourself → Introducing Your Coworker

_______ Chen. → _______ Robert.
_______ Ronald. → _______ Janette.
_______ Esther. → _______ Tony.

_______ coworkers. • _______ teammates.

tutorNotes.text: Read the instruction to the student.
For lower-level students, explain that column 1 uses "My name is," column 2 uses "This is," and the bottom uses "We are."

steps.title: Step 3 — Read the Dialogue
steps.instructionEn: Read the dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Good morning. My name is Evan. It's my first day today.
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 에반입니다. 오늘은 제 첫 출근 날입니다.

dialogue.en: Pleased to meet you, Evan. My name is Akihiro. This is Sandra. We are coworkers.
dialogue.kr: 만나서 반갑습니다, 에반 씨. 제 이름은 아키히로입니다. 이쪽은 산드라 씨입니다. 우리는 동료입니다.

dialogue.en: Pleased to meet you, too, Akihiro and Sandra.
dialogue.kr: 아키히로 씨, 산드라 씨, 저도 만나서 반갑습니다.

tutorNotes.text: Read the dialogue with the student.
For lower-level students, read each line first and have them repeat. Then role-play.

dialogue.en: Hello. My name is Shirley. I'm the new secretary.
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 셜리입니다. 저는 새로운 비서입니다.

tutorNotes.text: Read the instruction. Ask: "Is it clear?"
For lower-level students, guide step by step.

challenge.scenarioEn: A new coworker joins your team. Using today's patterns and the table below, introduce yourself and your coworkers. Then, say that you are coworkers.
challenge.scenarioKr: 새 동료가 팀에 합류합니다. 오늘의 패턴과 아래 표를 사용하여 자기소개와 동료 소개를 합시다. 그리고 동료임을 알려줍시다.

guideQuestions.text: Hi! Nice to meet you. May I know the names of the others, as well?
Do you work with all of them?

tutorNotes.text: "Are you ready for the challenge?"
Make the discussion as natural as possible.
"Hello! My name's (your name). What's your name?"
Guide questions: 1) May I know the names of the others? 2) Do you work with all of them? 3) Are we teammates?
"Nice to meet you all!"
Give feedback after finishing.
This must be a real-life simulation, distinct from Practice. Corrections should only be done after the exercise.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category, then answer the questions.

categories.title: YOUR BOSS
questions: What is the name of your boss?
What is his/her position in the company?
Is he/she a good boss? Why?

categories.title: YOUR TEAMMATE
questions: Can you name one of your teammates?
What is his/her task in the team?

categories.title: YOUR FAVORITE COWORKER
questions: What do you like about him/her?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's have a discussion."
Ask the student to choose a category.
If the student can't choose, pick one. If time remains, let the student choose another category.
